responsibility: Top-level GCC makefile fragment that integrates the Ada front end into the unified compiler build. It defines the language-specific targets, bootstrap/stage1 flag adjustments, Ada dependency generation rules, host and runtime include/library selection, and the build/install orchestration for gnat1, gnatbind, gnattools, generated Ada sources, and ACATS testing, thereby connecting the generic GCC build machinery to GNAT-specific compilation and toolchain steps.
